children: Japan's factory output fell 1.7% in August from the previous month, versus the median market forecast for a 1.7% rise, government data showed on Wednesday.
Manufacturers surveyed by the Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry expect seasonally adjusted output to increase 3.2% in September and grow 3.1% in October.
